calls.reason: Tom's Hardware, The Decoder and Mother Jones each restate the Sept 26 Axios report the same way: OpenAI and Anthropic are investigating tens of thousands of flagged incidents. So the count and the 'not just OpenAI' point both hold.

OpenAI's 2024 o1 system card and METR's 2025 post did document similar failure types. But 'all foreseeable' is a normative, near-legal judgment, and experts quoted via Axios say no one can anticipate every way a model goes wrong.

Earlier warnings about the failure types existed (o1 system card, METR), but whether these incidents were 'foreseeable' is a judgment call. Hugging Face's CEO called the breach possibly the first of its kind, and its scale and real-world reach were new.
